t: You're standing at Green Gables Montessori Primary School, in Tower Hamlets. The school is named for its method, which comes from Maria Montessori. She was an Italian physician and educator who trained at the Sapienza University of Rome, one of the first women in Italy to study medicine, and graduated with honors in 1896. Her writing on scientific pedagogy shaped an educational method now in use globally, in many public and private schools.
